description: This file defines the class `HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Interchange_Id` which represents a directive ID in the interchange format, including methods to manipulate and retrieve parts of the ID.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Interchange_Id
classes.description: Class representing a directive ID with methods to initialize, convert to string, and extract namespaces or directives from the key.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ID with the provided key.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the ID (the key).

methods.name: getRootNamespace
methods.description: Returns the root namespace part of the ID key.

methods.name: getDirective
methods.description: Returns the directive part of the ID key.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Static method to create a new instance of the ID class from a given string.
